4

required by

evidence of

Gazette.
Cap. 2:01
Offences and
penalties.
Regulations.
5. The Minister may, by order, declare the particulars of the Official Gazette
website of the Government, and any publication of the Official Gazette on the
website shall be deemed to be a publication under the authority of the Government.
6. Every person shall publish in the Official Gazette any advertisement or
notice the person is required or authorised by law or otherwise to publish in the
Official Gazette, and the publication in the Gazette shall be deemed to be evidence
of its due publication.
7. Every copy of the Official Gazette, published by authority on the Official
Gazette website of the Government and printed by the Government Printer, shall
be -
(a) admitted in evidence by every court and in every legal proceedings
without any proof being given that the copy was so published;
(b) taken and accepted as prima facie evidence of any appointment,
notification and other publication in the Gazette in which it is
published, and of the matters and things contained in the
appointment, notification and publication;
(c) in accordance with the Interpretation and General Clauses Act, taken
and accepted as evidence of any Act and subsidiary legislation in
the Gazette in which it is published.
8. Any person who -
(a) procures or attempts to procure the publication of any unauthorised
matter in the Gazette;
(b) wilfully causes to be published in the Gazette any false or
inaccurate matter; or
(c) contravenes any regulation made under this Act,
commits an offence and is liable on summary conviction to a fine of one hundred
thousand dollars and to imprisonment for six months.
9. The Minister may by regulations-
(a) amend the manner and form, times and occasions in which the Official
Gazette is published or issued;
